entities.name: Jānis Porziņģis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jānis Porziņģis is a Latvian former professional basketball player. At a height of 2.02 m, he played at the small forward position. He is the older brother of Golden State Warriors forward Kristaps Porziņģis.
